newsitem.title: FRANCE: France seen raising 1996 grain harvest estimate.
newsitem.headline: France seen raising 1996 grain harvest estimate.

text.p: France has raised its estimate for the 1996 grain harvest to 61 million tonnes from a previous target of 57.3 million tonnes and 53.6 million tonnes produced in 1995, grain industry sources said on Tuesday.
The farm ministry is expected to officially release the figures later this week, they said.
The ministry has also revised upwards its estimate for the soft wheat crop to 34.1 million tonnes from a previous target of 31.3 million tonnes and 29.8 million tonnes produced in 1995.
The new estimate assumed the soft wheat yield would rise to 7.16 tonnes per hectare from 6.56 tonnes forecast last month and 6.61 tonnes in 1995.
The wheat area was seen declining to 4.768 million ha from 4.772 million ha forecast last month, but should still be higher than 1995's 4.513 million.
Barley output was revised upwards to 9.3 million tonnes from 8.6 million forecast last month and from 7.7 million tonnes produced last year.
The new estimate assumed a barley yield of 6.09 tonnes against 5.68 last month and 5.54 tonnes last year.
The total barley area was seen rising to 1.53 million ha from 1.52 million last month and 1.38 million ha last year.
The maize crop was revised to 13.8 million tonnes from 13.6 million last month and 12.8 million last year.
The estimate assumed a maize yield of 7.99 tonnes per ha against 7.88 last month and 7.72 last year.
The maize area was seen rising to 1.73 million ha from 1.66 million last year. The previous area forecast was also 1.73 million ha.
